description: Controlled single-seed 15000-round Task 2 independent-target experiment. Relative target distance is replaced by separate data-derived coin-distance (far to very near) and best-bomb-quality (weak to strong) classes while the exact-best coin and bomb masks remain unchanged. Reward v3.2 preserves every v3.1.1 outcome, bomb-site, movement, self-kill, and urgency value; only relative-priority navigation shaping is replaced by bounded independent class-conditioned mask adherence that rewards either side of a true conflict equally and leaves the objective boundary to long-term returns.
